# TrustyAccordion

`Layout` · composition depth: `base`

A vertically stacked set of collapsible panels on their own surface.

Each item's `value` names both what `v-model` reports and the slot that fills that panel's body. The item's `label` and `icon` render in the header; the body is the item's `description` followed by that slot, and nothing else — so an item that is only prose needs no slot, and an item that is only controls needs no description.

`single` (the default) keeps at most one panel open and lets you close it again; `multiple` reports an array. Every header is a `<button>` inside an `<h3>`: Space and Enter toggle, arrow keys walk the headers, Home and End jump to the ends.

**Use it when**
- several related groups share one surface and not all of them need to be visible at once: settings categories, parameter groups, configuration sections.

**Don't use it for**
- one standalone collapsible area inside another component — no surface, no group behaviour: use TrustyCollapsible
- swapping one region between peer views, where exactly one is always visible: use TrustyTabs
- content the user always needs: keep it outside the accordion

```ts
import { TrustyAccordion } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `{ value: T; label: string; icon?: `${string}:${string}` \| undefined; description?: string \| undefined; disabled?: boolean \| undefined; }[]` | *required* | The panels, in order. Each item: - `value`: unique value v-model reports when the panel is open; also the name of the slot that fills this panel's body (one named slot per value) - `label`: header text - `icon`: leading icon name (Iconify `collection:icon`, e.g. `ph:gear`) - `description`: muted paragraph shown above the slot - `disabled`: disable just this panel |
| `type` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | `"single"` | `single` = at most one panel open; `multiple` = any number. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable every panel. |
| `modelValue` | `T \| T[]` | — |  |

## Events

- `update:modelValue` — `[value: T \| T[] \| undefined]`

## Examples in Storybook

- Default — Every panel closed — how the group first renders.
- OpenPanel — One panel open; the model is that item's `value`.
- DescriptionOnly — `about` carries only a `description`, so its body is prose with no slot — and no second header inside the panel.
- Multiple — `multiple` lets any number stand open at once; the model is an array.
- Disabled — Group-level `disabled` locks every header; per-item `disabled` locks one — as `sensor-cleaning` is throughout.
- LabelsOnly — Labels only: no icons, no descriptions, bodies filled entirely by slots.
- WithNestedCollapsible — The two components together: an accordion panel groups the sections, and a `TrustyCollapsible` inside it tucks away the fields most operators skip.
